boundaries: Selected Bench damage requires a lexical BENCH scope; damaged-target filters exclude the Active and undamaged Bench.
Damage uses the attack pipeline, whereas placing counters does not apply Weakness/Resistance.
Fixed multi-target counters select distinct Pokemon and resolve as much as possible on short fields.
Remaining-HP counters never heal; exact counter Knock Out uses equality.
Stadium damage bonus reads presence before the after-attack Stadium discard.
Unlimited Energy transfers move one physical card currently providing the type and cannot select the same destination host.
Private deck searches may fail to find; mandatory public discard recovery selects all available cards up to the printed quantity.
Unrecognized companion text keeps the whole card unsupported.
